messages:
sophie: Maia-v1 int8 onboard - failing locale smoke: vertical JP with furigana + embedded Hebrew gershayim (״) yields reordered pieces and BLEU regression. anyone seen this mix before?

ryan: can you drop a minimal repro and the smoke stats?

sophie: pasted repro below (staging):
```
INPUT (vertical preserved):
\u6f22[]{ruby}

REF: "Kanji (furigana) \u05f4Hebrew\u05f4"
MAIA-v0.9 (gold): "Kanji (furigana) \u05f4Hebrew\u05f4"
MAIA-v1-int8: "Kanji\u05f4Hebrew\u05f4 (furigana)"

Eval: BLEU 28.9 -> 25.0 (\u22123.9), sample_failures 9/400
```

tokenizer-bot: Tokenizer trace requested. Running locale-tokenize with debug flag...

ryan: looks like the punctuation (gershayim) is being pulled inside the furigana group in int8 run. Could be normalization or a post-token-merge step.

ci-bot: CI summary for maia-v1-int8: BLEU \u22123.7, chrF \u22121.4, regressions flagged on vertical-jp-smoke.

claire: repro steps? I'll try on staging.

sophie: repro command (staging):
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"maia-v1-int8","input":"\u6f22[\u3075\u308a]{ruby}\u05f4Hebrew\u05f4","options":{"vertical":true}}' https://inference.staging.redwood/api/v1/generate | jq .
```

claire: reproduced. Token delta from tokenizer-run:
TOKS v0.9: [\u6f22][ZWSP][ruby-open][\u3075\u308a][ruby-close][\u05f4][Hebrew][\u05f4]
TOKS int8 : [\u6f22][ruby-open][\u3075\u308a][ZWSP][\u05f4][Hebrew][\u05f4][ruby-close]

ryan: that explains the surface reorder in generation. Any recent changes to the unicode normalizer or the furigana handling?

sophie: tokenization-normalizer PR landed ~3580000000 (by @mika). int8 quant build also included a small KV-cache packing reorder. we need a two-way bisect to see root cause.

claire: quick experiment: export USE_LEGACY_TOKENIZER=1 and run int8 binary -> BLEU 28.6 (near baseline). So old tokenizer fixes it.

sophie: thanks. plan: revert the normalizer tweak for the canary, add an opt-in flag for the new normalization, and create a regression test for vertical + ruby + RTL/Hebrew mixing. filing ticket INF-3301.

ci-bot: Created INF-3301: "maia-v1-int8 vertical+japanese+furigana + Hebrew gershayim tokenization regression" and queued extended-locale-smoke job.

ryan: good triage. also add a tokenizer-level trace to the smoke artifacts so we can diff easily in future.

sophie: will PR test + opt-out today, assign reviewers: @mika @ryan. thanks everyone.
